name: Weft
description: The token of Weft (weft.fi): an AI agent that turns a market view in plain English into rules and trades them from your own wallet. Half of every fee Weft earns buys $WEFT on the open market, about every ten minutes: 50% goes back to traders, 20% to strategy creators, 30% is burned. Holders pay 25% less in fees, whales 50% less.
